reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：标识与标量 → 分页契约 → 错误契约 → 幂等契约 → 事件契约 → 鉴权上下文契约。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Identifiers and Scalars → Paging Contract → Error Contract → Idempotency Contract → Event Contract → Authorization Context. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
